title: World Genesis — маленький огонь, большая история
disclosure: Реальные кадры разработки • часть сцен подготовлена
notes: Footage spans alpha versions 0.5 to 0.10; the film does not label all footage as version 0.10.
Gameplay crops remove UI only; pixels are not repainted. Static shots and short tail freezes are editorial choices, recorded below.
Original clips sample native Player frames near 10 Hz; 30 fps export duplicates samples and does not claim new motion detail.
Narration provider and voice identity are read from voice-receipt.json; this edit does not prescribe or impersonate a voice.
No optical flow, generated interpolation, GPU rendering, or source modification. Music is an existing project track.
